edits.new: A valid counterexample refutes that direction without further restriction tests. Before any full-coverage conclusion, explicitly test each applicable parent requirement absent from the child's explicit wording: try a case that violates that requirement, adjudicating its admission under the whole child and exclusion from all parent alternatives and permitted connections. Identify any child requirement or necessary implication that rules it out.
edits.old: A valid counterexample refutes that direction without further restriction tests. Before any full-coverage conclusion, explicitly test each applicable parent identity or consumer restriction absent from the child's explicit wording: put an outside-class entity in the constrained role and adjudicate the concrete case against the whole child and all parent alternatives and permitted connections. Identify any necessary implication excluding it.

edits.new: including the prerequisite restriction tests for positive coverage
edits.old: including the outside-class prerequisite for positive coverage
